map.本工具采用 Mifflin-St Jeor（1990），对现代人群精度优于经典: This tool uses Mifflin-St Jeor (1990), which is more accurate for modern populations than the classic Harris-Benedict and is recommended by most guidelines; the two usually differ by <5% and can serve as cross-references.
map.不建议。BMR 是完全静息最低消耗，长期摄入低于 BMR 会触发代谢下降、肌肉流: Not recommended. BMR is the minimum expenditure at complete rest; long-term intake below BMR triggers a metabolic slowdown and muscle loss. For fat loss, create a 300-500 kcal deficit based on TDEE rather than dieting below BMR.
